name: Expandable no-kink garden hose
problem: Gardeners with small yards or patios want a hose that doesn't kink and coils away small, unlike a heavy rubber hose that is hard to store
buyer: US homeowners with small-to-medium yards and renters with patio/balcony container gardens

observed_price_range.basis: FACT - Home Depot listings: Flexi Hose 75 ft at $44.88 (after a $25 off promotion) up to Flexi Hose 150 ft at $103.00. Note: shorter 50 ft versions of some brands (e.g. Hydrotech) promo down to $24.98, which is below the brief's floor - flagged PRICE_VARIANCE, so a 75 ft+ size is the size that reliably clears $30

seasonality: UNKNOWN via Trends (unreachable). ASSUMPTION: outdoor watering products are plausibly used more in US spring/summer months, based on the use case, not confirmed by any trend data source

demonstration_value.justification: The hose visibly tripling in length under water pressure and shrinking back down when the tap is off is one of the most demonstrable, ad-proven silent visuals in this whole sweep

weight_and_pack_form.estimate: roughly 0.9-1.4 kg for a 50-75 ft hose - borderline against the brief's under-1kg target
weight_and_pack_form.method: No manufacturer shipping weight was found in search snippets. Reasoned from the general category (a latex inner tube plus fabric-braid outer shell, brass fittings) which is lighter than a rigid rubber hose but not as light as a folded textile good.

ad_policy_risk: ASSUMPTION: moderate - no inherent platform-restricted category, but the recall below means any 'burst-proof' or similar durability claim in ad creative carries real liability exposure, not just a policy risk
specific_complaint_language: Not separately searched (the CPSC recall record below already documents the core failure mode in the category's own words: hoses bursting)
cpsc_recall_history: FACT - Winston Products recalled 5/8-inch HydroTech Expandable 'Burst-Proof' Hoses in 2025 (hoses manufactured on/before 31 Aug 2024). CPSC: 'at least 222 reports of the hoses bursting, resulting in at least 29 injuries, including one bone bruise, two sprains and five reports of temporarily impaired hearing from the sound of the hose bursting.' Sold at Ace Hardware, Amazon, Do It Best, Home Depot, Target, Walmart and others, Jan 2021-Apr 2025, $20-$136.

evidence.quote: Flexi Hose 3/4 in x 75 ft. with 8 Function Nozzle Expandable Garden Hose, Lightweight & No-Kink Flexible, Black 17103 ... priced at $44.88 after a $25 OFF promotion

The firm has received at least 222 reports of the hoses bursting, resulting in at least 29 injuries, including one bone bruise, two sprains and five reports of temporarily impaired hearing from the sound of the hose bursting.

notes_for_other_agents: Flagging hard for the risk/supplier agents: this is not an unrelated-adjacent recall, it is the exact product type (expandable/collapsible garden hose) under a well-known brand, with a specific, well-documented failure mode (internal bladder bursting under pressure) and a real injury count. Any sourcing decision here would need burst-pressure spec verification and probably third-party test evidence before this could be defensible to advance, on top of the usual weight/freight questions.
